## Scope check

Pixelith is deliberately small: two models, local-only inference, one HTTP API,
one static web UI. Please confirm how your request fits that.

- [ ] This does not require sending user data off the machine.
- [ ] This does not require an account, an API key, or a paid service.
- [ ] If it adds a model, I have noted its licence, source, file size, and
      roughly how it compares to the existing `fast` and `quality` entries.
- [ ] If it changes performance characteristics, I have said what I measured
      and on what hardware.
